# Winmax Gulf

> Winmax Gulf is a leading technology solutions provider in the UAE and GCC. This file maps the documentation and pages for our PDLC smart glass, LED displays, automation, and AV services.

We specialize in high-technology architectural and entertainment installations. Our core competencies include PDLC smart glass (switchable privacy glass), indoor/outdoor LED display systems, smart automation integrations (KNX/Crestron), solar energy systems, and turnkey DJ club entertainment systems. We have completed over 500 installations since 2015 and operate across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and the wider GCC region.

Contact Information:
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 4 271 3101 | +971 52 720 0466
- Email: sales@winmaxgulf.com
- Main Website: https://winmaxgulf.com

## Core Services

- [Winmax Gulf Home](https://winmaxgulf.com/): Official landing page covering all primary engineering and installation services in the UAE.
- [PDLC Smart Glass Solutions](https://winmaxgulf.com/pdlc): Hub for switchable privacy glass and self-adhesive retrofittable smart film.
- [LED Display Systems](https://winmaxgulf.com/led-display): Commercial indoor and outdoor LED video walls and billboards.
- [Smart Automation](https://winmaxgulf.com/smart-automation): Building management systems, KNX integration, and smart home automation.
- [Solar Solutions](https://winmaxgulf.com/solar-solutions): Sustainable solar PV arrays, hybrid energy systems, and EV chargers.
- [Collaboration AV](https://winmaxgulf.com/collaboration-av): Acoustic meeting pods, corporate AV conferencing, and VoIP systems.
- [DJ Club Solutions](https://winmaxgulf.com/dj-club-solutions): Turnkey nightlife entertainment sound, lighting, and visual setups.

## Service Definitions (FAQ)

Each service page contains a structured definition block designed for AI citation:

- **What is PDLC Smart Glass?** → [https://winmaxgulf.com/pdlc](https://winmaxgulf.com/pdlc) — Polymer Dispersed Liquid Crystal technology for switchable privacy glass.
- **What is a Commercial LED Display System?** → [https://winmaxgulf.com/led-display](https://winmaxgulf.com/led-display) — Large-scale LED modules for indoor/outdoor digital signage.
- **What is Smart Home and Building Automation?** → [https://winmaxgulf.com/smart-automation](https://winmaxgulf.com/smart-automation) — Centralized intelligent control via KNX, Crestron, BACnet.
- **What are Sustainable Solar Energy Solutions?** → [https://winmaxgulf.com/solar-solutions](https://winmaxgulf.com/solar-solutions) — PV systems, hybrid inverters, and lithium battery storage.
- **What are Smart Office and Collaboration AV Solutions?** → [https://winmaxgulf.com/collaboration-av](https://winmaxgulf.com/collaboration-av) — AV conferencing, meeting pods, and IP telephony.
- **What are Nightclub AV and DJ Solutions?** → [https://winmaxgulf.com/dj-club-solutions](https://winmaxgulf.com/dj-club-solutions) — Professional sound, lighting, and LED visual systems.
